explication: OpenClaude is a terminal-first coding-agent CLI spanning local and hosted model providers. The principal workflow takes a user prompt, builds system context, runs model/tool interactions, streams results, and persists conversation history. Supporting capabilities include provider setup, agents and tasks, MCP and plugins, and session resume. The QueryEngine excerpts establish its context, input-processing, and transcript-storage calls; other subsystem links reflect README-described capabilities, not inspected call sites.
